mapper.select: SELECT mm.id, mm.user_id, su.nickname AS user_name, mm.card_id, mc.card_name, mc.card_type, mc.price AS card_price, mm.start_date, mm.end_date, CASE WHEN mc.card_type = 'TIMES' THEN NULL WHEN mm.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, NOW()) ELSE NULL END AS remaining_days, mm.remaining_times, mm.status, mm.frozen_at, mm.created_at FROM member_membership mm LEFT JOIN membership_card mc ON mm.card_id = mc.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON mm.user_id = su.id WHERE mm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC

SELECT mm.id, mm.user_id, su.nickname AS user_name, mm.card_id, mc.card_name, mc.card_type, mc.price AS card_price, mm.start_date, mm.end_date, CASE WHEN mc.card_type = 'TIMES' THEN NULL WHEN mm.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, NOW()) ELSE NULL END AS remaining_days, mm.remaining_times, mm.status, mm.frozen_at, mm.created_at FROM member_membership mm LEFT JOIN membership_card mc ON mm.card_id = mc.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON mm.user_id = su.id ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC
